description: Django REST Framework serializers for user authentication, recipe management, categories, ingredients, images, and favorites in a recipe application.

classes.name: UserSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for user model (safe fields only).

classes.name: RecipeIngredientSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for recipe ingredients, including nested ingredient details.

classes.name: RecipeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for recipes, handling nested categories, ingredients, images, and creation/update logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recipe with associated categories and ingredients.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe, including categories and ingredients.
